scripts.check:deploy: npm run check:preview-config && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.preview.toml
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run check:preview-config && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.preview.toml
scripts.rollback:preview: npm run check:preview-config && wrangler rollback --config wrangler.preview.toml --message "Automatic rollback after failed Preview smoke test"
scripts.db:migrate:preview: npm run check:preview-config && wrangler d1 migrations apply kunonline-preview --remote --config wrangler.preview.toml
scripts.db:preview:setup: npm run db:init && npm run db:commerce
